title: MODS: Moderating a Mixture of Document Speakers to Summarize Debatable Queries in Document Collections

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the balance of opposing ('yes' vs. 'no') perspectives in summaries by calculating the KL divergence of the stance distribution of cited documents against a uniform distribution (fairness metric), as well as using human evaluation and LLM-as-a-judge to score the balance and diversity of perspectives.
